title: #217 bar 2: CI runs once a day on main so the flake window sees macOS and Linux every day, and the SpecSync Archive jobs take the run's own commit as base when the event has none
description: #217 bar 2: CI runs once a day on main so the flake window sees macOS and Linux every day, and the SpecSync Archive jobs take the run's own commit as base when the event has none
acceptance_criteria: ci.yml runs on a daily schedule as well as on pushes to main and pull requests; the SpecSync Archive base falls back to github.sha, so a scheduled run gives check-specsync-archive.py a real base; tests/package.rs fails naming the missing schedule or fallback (red then green)

answers.constraints: specs/cli/cli.3md: hosted runners have no Git identity, and a lifted bound must be searched for in tests and CI scripts too; check-specsync-archive.py refuses an empty or all-zero --base; GitHub may delay or drop scheduled runs at busy times, so the cron is set off the hour
